data.narrative:
Sygaldry Technologies is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Rigetti, Friedson, and Keiser, having raised $139M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable here, using total capital raised ($139M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $278M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable; while 8 same-sector peers exist in quantum computing, none satisfy the minimum threshold of three datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier, making an all-sector median unreliably broad.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $236M (low) to $320M (high), centered on $278M. This single-method output carries material uncertainty. The primary constraint is the fragmentation of the quantum computing peer set across vastly different architectures, development maturity, and commercialization timelines—none of which yield sufficient same-stage cohorts for statistical triangulation. Validation would benefit from granular stage-by-stage precedent data within quantum hardware specifically, and clarity on Sygaldry's technical approach relative to competing modalities.
